Marta Nguyen: quick heads-up — the link scanner (link-checker) flagged ~18 dead anchors in the runtime guide and a couple console pages. i'm going to run a smokecheck and push tiny redirects for obvious 404s, but need owners to review before mass replace. pinging @Liam @Tara
Liam O'Connor: thanks @Marta — can you paste the failing anchor list here? i can take runtime/serving files.
Marta Nguyen: sure, pasted the list below (copied from link-checker):
```
site/runtime/serving.md#kv-cache-management
site/runtime/serving.md#batching-policy
site/console/alerts.md#alert-routing-rules
site/console/deployments.md#canary-rollouts
site/kb/how-to-write-prompts.md#prompt-templates
... + several image 403s from cdn.partner.com
```

Tara Patel: I can pick up the console pages. lmk when you open a PR and i'll do a quick review.
docs-bot: Link-checker report for branch 'docs/fix-anchor-scan-2059991111' — 18 dead anchors, 3 image 403s, 2 external 404s. https://ci.redwood/link-checker/2059991111
Marta Nguyen: created draft branch `docs/fix-anchor-scan-2059991111` and pushed a few sed-based fixes for anchor formatting. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521
Sachin Rao: FYI the 2 external 404s point to partner blog posts (partner.example.com). do we want to swap to archive.org snapshots or reach out to partner? archive sounds faster.
Tara Patel: archive.org snapshots are fine as a stopgap. please add a FIXME comment in the markdown so we can attempt upstream fixes later.
Liam O'Connor: quick review: merged runtime/serving fixes, left two tiny comments about heading IDs (they were auto-generated with punctuation). :thumbsup:
Marta Nguyen: thanks all! i'll replace the external links with archive snapshots, add FIXME comments, and tag the partner contact in the follow-up ticket. assigning ownership: runtime -> Liam, console -> Tara, kb/how-to -> Sachin. Will follow up in #docs when partner responds.
